body: Paramjit Singh Soni (Promoter, Executive Director & Vice-Chairman) on the Q2FY25 call (2024-11-08), prompted: "clearly, long term, I don't want to be below 25%, very clearly" Metric: ROCE. Target: > 25%. Deadline: 2027-03-31 (vague). Specificity: precise. Status as of 2026-11-19: PARTLY. Evidence: FY26 ROCE 22% (screener). Re-derived TTM to Sep-2026: EBIT (PBT 258 + interest 13) / (equity 944 + debt 162) = ~24.5%. Chairman claims 'north of 27%' TTM (2026-08-05; definition not given). Close to target, not decisively met.
